title: Toward Appraisal-Structured Latent Control Representations in Language Models: A Preregistered Hypothesis and Experimental Design for Task-Induced Response-Strategy Modulation
description: A preregistered hypothesis and experimental-design note proposing that several known single-behavior latent directions in language models (refusal, abstention, uncertainty reporting, evaluation awareness) may be special cases of a more general family of task-induced, appraisal-structured latent control representations that partially govern response-strategy selection across semantic domains. This version reports no experimental results.
